review_mode: Read-only source review; no generator, learner, primary, fixture or noise execution.
snapshot_note: Runner was under active integration. This initial review binds the last observed draft hash above; it is not final executable approval. Root will provide final hashes for closure.
accepted_source_properties: Only canonical index/dt/current/measured-voltage records and immutable source ID are passed to the separate C process; truth stays in generator/root/scorer processes.
Constant-current closed forms use carried event-entering state and integer within-event counts; chunks do not restart physical dwells.

One scalar normal call occurs per source record. Queries/checkpoints/journal reconstruction do not draw noise. Full PCG64 state, charge compensation, actual clock and rolling observation hash are serialized.

Manifest identity excludes future-output digests and includes schedule, seed, contract and runtime/source hashes. Warm restore validates the manifest and snapshot envelope; cold consumes the baseline suffix without plant/RNG restart.

Journal records retain exact entering state, PCG64 fields, compensated charge and hash-chain bytes with CRCs; arbitrary-index reconstruction reuses the same deterministic closed form and validates the reconstructed snapshot.

Existing generator tests cover independent physical/charge formulas, interior and event-boundary restore, different chunk sizes, all toy journal snapshots, corruption rejection and fresh-process suffix parity.

Observed R1-R5 integrations add pre-C source digest/count/grid/charge/clock checks, prelaunch arm registration, partial learner accounting, supplemental truth forwarding, deadline checks and metadata/scorer caps. Those earlier draft gaps are not repeated as new findings.

findings.issue: Generator SIGINT uses Python's default KeyboardInterrupt. It can arrive after the RNG advances or during sequential physical/hash/charge assignments, before next_index is committed. The failure handler then serializes a partially updated source and reports next_index-start as the exact noise count. Runner currently treats presence of that failure file as exact accounting.
findings.consequence: A cooperative resource stop can preserve an inconsistent snapshot or undercount draws while claiming exact state/counts.
findings.requested_fix: Use deferred signal handling and stop at a complete source-record boundary. If state or count is not recoverable, mark it unavailable/unknown rather than exact. Keep hard-kill journal counts explicitly lower bounds.
findings.root_response: Assigned to generator author for safe-boundary signal handling.

findings.issue: monitor combines os.wait4 with Popen.send_signal/kill. The installed Python implementation calls poll()->waitpid inside send_signal; if the child exits between wait4(WNOHANG) and signaling, Popen can reap it, and the next wait4 raises ChildProcessError.
findings.consequence: The stop path loses the exact wait4 resource result and normal execution receipt even when the worker has exited.
findings.requested_fix: Keep wait4 as the sole reaper and signal the known unreaped child directly with os.kill, handling ProcessLookupError, including escalation.

findings.issue: After Popen succeeds, monitor has no exception cleanup. A parent KeyboardInterrupt or I/O exception from progress/log/output monitoring exits monitor while a live child may continue generating or ingesting. run_study catches BaseException and can proceed to failure reporting/scoring.
findings.consequence: The first-stop and one-worker rules can be violated; primary work continues without supervision or exact accounting.
findings.requested_fix: Every exceptional monitor exit must stop and reap the child, allow at most one second for cooperative capture, escalate if needed, and preserve the original error plus execution/capture-unavailable status.

findings.issue: The warm source audit verifies files against their own generation receipt, but comparison with the baseline observation suffix and carried generator state first occurs after all warm C deliveries. An internally checksummed divergent continuation therefore reaches C before the available source mismatch is detected.
findings.consequence: Warm source failure is detected later than necessary, after up to42000 additional learner deliveries.
findings.requested_fix: Move source-only warm parity checks for observation suffix, source checkpoints/final state and chain endpoint before warm C launch. Keep learner metric/query/checkpoint parity after C.

next_action: Close these findings against final source hashes and perform the independent executable-receipt/conformance review before any primary generation. This initial review grants no execution admission.
